assets.title: Bee — Gobkit Free Animal Pack Vol. 2
assets.author: Gobkit
assets.adaptation: Original rigged GLB; fixed barycentric samples follow its idle clip as Gaussian splats. Added a bounded hovering route.

assets.title: Butterfly (Animated)
assets.author: Čestmír Dammer (CDmir); TinyWorlds
assets.adaptation: Original butterfly.blend and butterfly-skin.png exported with Blender 4.5.15 using scripts/export-cc0-butterfly.py. Original Flying action retained. Textured, alpha-aware samples follow the rig as Gaussian splats. Added a slow hovering route.

assets.title: Potted Plant Splat
assets.author: Poly Haven (source model); DX.GL (Gaussian conversion); Innerscene (format conversion)
assets.adaptation: All 51,278 original 32-byte native Gaussian records retained, with a uniform scene scale and 180-degree X rotation. No resampling or decimation. An original procedural tabletop is added.

notes: The bee and butterfly originate as animated CC0 meshes and are rendered exclusively as splats. The plant is a native Gaussian capture. Local Ghibli reference images guide the original procedural gardens and are not included in these CC0 asset licenses.
